_doc: Grid plan for the icons of the town's new goods (docs/city_new_goods.md): 4 pictures of 3x3 equal cells instead of 36 (the game-assets skill: always a grid). Not generated yet. Cell order is row by row, left to right: ids[0] is row 1 left, ids[8] row 3 right. After a run: save the picture at `output`, write its sidecar next to it (service, tool, every argument, job id, output URL, credits), cut it into 9 equal cells (the same cutting as tools/characters/cut_grid.py, 3 columns x 3 rows) into textures/localized/ru/icon_<id>.jpg, look at every cell, then unreal/scripts/import_hall_assets.py. Each cell's own words are icon_<id>.prompt in localization/assets.json.

grids.prompt: Nine inventory icons for a moody adventure game, arranged as a 3 by 3 grid of equal square cells on one picture: in every cell one object centred and filling most of the cell, softly lit from the upper left, painterly realistic style, plain dark warm-grey cloth background with a faint vignette, the same background and the same scale in every cell (every object drawn at the same icon size, as large as the cell allows with a margin), no borders, frames or lines between the cells, nothing crossing a cell edge, exactly one object or one small group per cell, no text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere, not even on the objects. Everyday goods of a 1970s-80s Soviet seaside town, no real brands. Row 1, left: a brick-shaped loaf of dark Soviet rye bread with a shiny brown crust and a few caraway seeds, on a scrap of plain wrapping paper. Row 1, middle: five glossy golden bagel rings sprinkled with poppy seeds, threaded on a loop of rough twine. Row 1, right: a round golden sweet bun with a well of white baked curd cheese in its centre, on a square of greaseproof paper. Row 2, left: a small round shortcrust pastry basket filled with piped pale cream shaped like two tiny mushrooms and a drop of red jam, on a little white saucer. Row 2, middle: three round ring doughnuts heavily dusted with powdered sugar, spilling out of a plain brown paper cone. Row 2, right: a large half-moon fried pasty with a crimped edge and a blistered golden crust, on a square of greaseproof paper. Row 3, left: a dozen small boiled pelmeni dumplings on a plain white paper plate with a spoonful of sour cream on top and a small aluminium fork. Row 3, middle: an open sandwich: a slice of white bread with a square slice of yellow cheese on top, on a small white saucer. Row 3, right: two round domed Russian gingerbread cakes covered in a thin crackled white sugar glaze.
